why:
All three checks confirm the finding, and no upstream/downstream layer rescues it.

(1) The quoted sentence exists verbatim at hooks.md:1082: "In addition to the [common input fields](#common-input-fields), Setup hooks receive a `trigger` field set to either `\"init\"` or `\"maintenance\"`:". The firing rule is also verbatim at :1061 — "Fires only when you launch Claude Code with `--init-only`, or with `--init` or `--maintenance` in [non-interactive mode](/docs/en/headless) with the `-p` flag. It doesn't fire on normal startup." — and the matcher table at :1063-1067 maps `init` -> `claude --init-only`/`claude -p --init`, `maintenance` -> `claude -p --maintenance`.

(2) packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.ts:107 says exactly what was claimed: `await options.emit('Setup', { hook_event_name: 'Setup', source: 'pi-runtime', lifecycle_version: 1 })`, inside `pi.on('session_start', ...)` behind a `sessionStarted` once-guard. A `grep -a` for `'Setup'` across packages/ and apps/ shows this is the ONLY Setup emitter in the repo — no host-side emitter supplies a `trigger`.

(3) Layer up: the frozen contract row at packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:38 declares Setup as `kind: 'observational'`, `terminalDelivery: 'once-per-session'`, `redactedPayload: ['source', 'lifecycle_version']` — the absence of `trigger` is baked into the versioned contract, not an oversight at the emitter. apps/cli/src/index.ts has no `--init-only`, `--init`, or `--maintenance` flag at all. Layer down: the two same-named restriction sets are about hook TYPES, not gating — CLAUDE_RESTRICTED_LIFECYCLE_EVENTS (format-adapters/claude.ts:152) and LIFECYCLE_RESTRICTED_HOOK_EVENTS (automations/types.ts:152) only limit Setup/SessionStart to `command`+`mcp_tool` handlers, and format-adapters.ts:124/183/200 maps an imported Claude plugin's `Setup` hook straight through to the Nessy `Setup` event. packages/shared/src/automations/conditions.test.ts:661-668 asserts the consequence directly: `matcherMatchesSdk(claude('init'), 'Setup', {source: 'pi-runtime'})` is `false` while `claude('*')` is `true` — i.e. an imported Setup hook is catch-all and fires every session.

Not one of the nine dated owner decisions in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (those are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries/listSessions). Not a rebrand, corporate-gateway, or dropped-subscription product difference either.

It IS a gap the fork has already recorded and deliberately deferred — but recorded is not closed. docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-inert-unit-b.md:24 tables it as "**no counterpart**"; :311 says "`Setup` carries `source` (doc: `trigger`)"; :322 says "Nessy's `Setup` fires every session start (Claude's only under `--init-only` / `-p --init` / `-p --maintenance`)" — both under the heading "Propagation found — reported, not fixed", with register category at :289 "documented, not implemented — Nessy has no --init/--maintenance launch mode". Shipped code carries the same reason at packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts:347 (MATCHER_INERT_AGENT_EVENTS) and emits a registration-time `plugin.hooks.matcher_never_matches` warning. Real consequence: a Claude plugin's Setup hook, whose documented purpose is "one-time dependency installation or scheduled cleanup that you trigger explicitly from CI or scripts", runs on every Nessy Pi session start.
correctedState: Confirmed with two precisions. (a) packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.ts:107 is the repo's only `Setup` emitter; it sends `{ hook_event_name: 'Setup', source: 'pi-runtime', lifecycle_version: 1 }` — no `trigger` — from `pi.on('session_start')` behind a `sessionStarted` once-guard, so it is once per Pi session, not once per turn. (b) The divergence is in event SEMANTICS, not a missing gate on an existing flag: Nessy's CLI has no `--init-only`/`--init`/`--maintenance` mode at all (apps/cli/src/index.ts), so there is no launch mode the event could be scoped to. The absence is contract-frozen (automations/types.ts:38 redactedPayload = ['source','lifecycle_version']) and knowingly recorded as `documented, not implemented — Nessy has no --init/--maintenance launch mode` (hooks-automation.ts:347; docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-inert-unit-b.md:24, :289, :311, :322), with a `plugin.hooks.matcher_never_matches` warning shown to hook authors at registration. Imported Claude Setup hooks still register and fire catch-all on every session (conditions.test.ts:661-668).
